text: U.S. stock indices rose on Thursday, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite all posting gains as investors reacted to easing Treasury yields and dovish remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller regarding potential interest rate stability. Market breadth was positive, with technology and communication services sectors leading the advance, while energy shares also drifted higher amid ongoing geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices stemming from the U.S.-Iran conflict. Despite the broader rally, some semiconductor stocks faced pressure following underwhelming earnings guidance from Broadcom, though overall volatility remained relatively contained.
